test_plan:
DUPLICATE RULE: keep "No two alike." and the "From our farm on the Sabie River" headline only on mens-belt, "From the Sabie River." only on hornback-belt, "A gift like no other." only on mens-belt and "Quietly individual." only on ipad-cover. Use the replacements above everywhere else. Every replacement fits the limits (on-image headline 22 characters or fewer, ending in a full stop; headline 40 or fewer). Also pick one casing for sublines (mens-belt, ipad-cover and key-ring are in capitals, the other lines in sentence case) so the bank looks like one brand.

LAUNCH FIRST (3 lines, one ad set each):
1) mens-belt (€149). This is the hero line. Its scale close-up is the strongest image in the bank, the price is mid-luxury and it is a natural gift for him going into Q4.
2) iphone-case (from €99). It reaches the widest audience as a daily-use item. Belly and hornback textures make clear before/after visuals, and "the case you see is the case you get" is a hook only Seronera can claim. Before launch, check which iPhone models the case fits, because a new generation comes out every September.
3) luggage-tag (€35). This is the entry price and an easy gift or stocking filler. It brings in cheap first purchases that teach the Meta pixel faster, and those buyers can later be retargeted with belts.
Hold back for now: hornback-belt (€199) and ipad-cover (€250) cost more and suit warm/retargeting audiences once the pixel has data. womens-belt (€100) comes 4th, timed for a gift-for-her push in November. key-ring (€25) works better as a cross-sell or bundle than as a standalone ad.

STRUCTURE: use ABO, one ad set per line, broad targeting with Advantage+ placements and the purchase objective, at about €25–40/day per ad set. Put 4 creatives in each ad set: 2 on the lead angle (1 static on-image + 1 short close-up video/Reel) and 2 challengers (one static each). Run for 7 days and make no edits for the first 3–4 days. Then cut creatives with low CTR or no add-to-cart after about 1.5× the target CPA in spend. Use the winners for the next angle round. Put "Free shipping" or "Duties & taxes included" in each first-round subline to reduce purchase friction.

LEAD ANGLE PER LINE:
- mens-belt: uniqueness ("No two alike." over a scale close-up). Challengers: gift ("A gift like no other.") and versatility ("Denim to tailoring.").
- iphone-case: what you see is what you get ("The one you see." / "Entirely your own."). Challengers: texture ("Texture you can feel." hornback €150) and gift ("Gift the daily carry.").
- luggage-tag: gift ("A gift that travels."). Challengers: utility ("Yours, easier to spot.") and uniqueness ("Scales of its own.").
